WITH before_sales AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(sales) as total_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY region
),
after_sales AS (
    SELECT region, SUM(sales) as total_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY region
),
region_pct AS (
    SELECT (a.total_sales_after * 1.0 / b.total_sales_before - 1) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM before_sales b
    JOIN after_sales a ON b.region = a.region
),
platform_before AS (
    SELECT platform, SUM(sales) as total_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY platform
),
platform_after AS (
    SELECT platform, SUM(sales) as total_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY platform
),
platform_pct AS (
    SELECT (a.total_sales_after * 1.0 / b.total_sales_before - 1) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM platform_before b
    JOIN platform_after a ON b.platform = a.platform
),
ageband_before AS (
    SELECT age_band, SUM(sales) as total_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY age_band
),
ageband_after AS (
    SELECT age_band, SUM(sales) as total_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY age_band
),
ageband_pct AS (
    SELECT (a.total_sales_after * 1.0 / b.total_sales_before - 1) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM ageband_before b
    JOIN ageband_after a ON b.age_band = a.age_band
),
demographic_before AS (
    SELECT demographic, SUM(sales) as total_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24
    GROUP BY demographic
),
demographic_after AS (
    SELECT demographic, SUM(sales) as total_sales_after
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 26 AND 36
    GROUP BY demographic
),
demographic_pct AS (
    SELECT (a.total_sales_after * 1.0 / b.total_sales_before - 1) * 100 as pct_change
    FROM demographic_before b
    JOIN demographic_after a ON b.demographic = a.demographic
),
customer_type_before AS (
    SELECT customer_type, SUM(sales) as total_sales_before
    FROM cleaned_weekly_sales
    WHERE week_number BETWEEN 13 AND 24

),

    FROM customer_type_before b
    JOIN customer_type_after a ON b.customer_type = a.customer_type
